title: Basics
description: Fundamental operations on a Binary Search Tree (BST).
identify: The task requires finding, inserting, or deleting elements while maintaining the BST property.
The problem asks for elements closest to a value (ceil/floor).
explanation: Leverage the BST property: left subtree has smaller values, right subtree has larger values, enabling O(H) time complexity.

title: Medium
description: More complex algorithmic problems utilizing the properties of Binary Search Trees.
identify: The task involves finding specific elements like K-th smallest/largest.
The problem requires validating or constructing a BST.
The problem requires finding relationships between nodes (LCA, Successor).
explanation: The most important property for medium BST problems is that the inorder traversal of a BST yields elements in strictly increasing order.
